DisableAutoDriverInstall.Name: Disable automatic driver installation
DisableAutoDriverInstall.Description: When enabled: Windows Update will no longer automatically install drivers.

DisableAccountSync.Name: Disable Cloud Search
DisableAccountSync.Description: When enabled: Microsoft account integration will be disabled in search.

DisableBingSearch.Name: Disable Bing in Search
DisableBingSearch.Description: When enabled: Windows Search will no longer use bing.

DisableSearchSuggestions.Name: Disable Search Suggestions
DisableSearchSuggestions.Description: When enabled: Search Suggestions will be disabled.

DisableCopilot.Name: Disable Copilot
DisableCopilot.Description: When enabled: Copilot will be disbaled.

DisableBackgroundUsage.Name: Disable search background usage
DisableBackgroundUsage.Description: Stops search from running in the background.

RecommendedSection.Name: Disable Recommended Section
RecommendedSection.Description: Disables Recommended Section in Start Menu

CursorShadow.Name: Disable Cursor Shadow
CursorShadow.Description: When enabled: the shadow under your cursor will be disabled.

MediaThumbnails.Name: Media Thumbnails
MediaThumbnails.Description: Toggles photo and video file thumbnails

EndTaskButton.Name: End Task in Taskbar
EndTaskButton.Description: Toggles the "End Task" button in the taskbar.

ShowHiddenFilesAndExtensions.Name: Show hidden files and file extensions
ShowHiddenFilesAndExtensions.Description: When enabled: you will be able to see hidden files and all file extensions.

ForceGenericFolderType.Name: Force Generic FolderType
ForceGenericFolderType.Description: When enabled: Kon OS will flush the folder view cache and set all folder types to Generic, which can improve the snappiness of File Explorer.

DisableTransparency.Name: Disable Transparency
DisableTransparency.Description: When enabled: all transparency in Windows will be disabled.

LogonBlur.Name: Disable Logon Blur
LogonBlur.Description: When enabled: the blur on the logon screen will be disabled.

LiveTiles.Name: Disable Live Tiles
LiveTiles.Description: When enabled: Live Tiles will be disabled on Windows 10.

LegacyContextMenu.Name: Legacy Context Menu
LegacyContextMenu.Description: When enabled: this disables the Windows 11 context menu.

DisableIPv6.Name: Disable IPv6
DisableIPv6.Description: Disables IPv6, which can mitigate privacy risks and improve internet stability.

ShutdownTweaks.Name: Shutdown Tweaks
ShutdownTweaks.Description: When enabled: Windows will no longer prompt you to save your work before shutting down.

CoreIsolation.Name: Core Isolation Tweaks
CoreIsolation.Description: When enabled: core isolation will be disabled.

TeredoTweaks.Name: Teredo Tweaks
TeredoTweaks.Description: When enabled: Teredo will be disabled. This can improve latency.

InvokeCommand: netsh.exe interface teredo set state disabled
netsh.exe interface teredo set state default

NoToastNotifications.Name: No Toast Notifications
NoToastNotifications.Description: Disable CPU-intensive Windows toast notifications completely.

DisableBackgroundApps.Name: Disable Background Apps
DisableBackgroundApps.Description: When enabled: (Most) apps will no longer run in the background

DisableWindowsInk.Name: Disable Inking and Typing
DisableWindowsInk.Description: When Enabled: Inking and Typing will be disabled.

NoFastUserSwitching.Name: Disable Fast User Swtiching
NoFastUserSwitching.Description: When Enabled: fast user switching will be disabled.

DisableTelemetry.Name: Disable Telemetry
DisableTelemetry.Description: When enabled: KonOS will attempt to disable as much telemetry as it can.

DisableActivityHistory.Name: Disable Activity History
DisableActivityHistory.Description: When Enabled: Activity History will be disabled.

DisableLocationServices.Name: Disable Location Services
DisableLocationServices.Description: When Enabled: Location services will be disabled across Windows.

DisableGameDVR.Name: Disable GameDVR
DisableGameDVR.Description: When Enabled: GameDVR will be disabled.

DisableFSO.Name: Disable FullScreen Optimizations
DisableFSO.Description: When enabled: Fullscreen optimizations (FSO) will be disabled. Windows will switch back to use Fullscreen Exclusive (FSE), potentially improving latency

DisableGameBar.Name: Disable Game Bar
DisableGameBar.Description: When enabled: Xbox Game Bar will be disabled.

DisableSmartScreen.Name: Disable SmartScreen
DisableSmartScreen.Description: When Enabled: Windows SmartScreen will be disabled.

DisableEdgeSmartScreen.Name: Disable SmartScreen (Edge)
DisableEdgeSmartScreen.Description: When Enabled: Windows SmartScreen for Microsoft Edge will be disabled.

DisableSmartScreenWS.Name: Disable Smart Screen (MS Store)
DisableSmartScreenWS.Description: When enabled: Windows SmartScreen will be disabled in the Microsoft Store.

LegacyBootMenu.Name: Legacy Boot Menu
LegacyBootMenu.Description: When Enabled: Windows will use the legacy boot menu, which is controlled with the arrow keys. This can improve startup times.

OptimizePlatformTimer.Name: Automatically choose the best platform timer
OptimizePlatformTimer.Description: Deletes "useplatformclock" value in BCD, which lets Windows automatically choose the best platform timer for your computer. This can help if your PC has been forced to the wrong platform timer.

NoBootGUI.Name: No Boot GUI
NoBootGUI.Description: Disables boot gui (spinny circle), slightly increasing startup times.

DisableUsePlatformTick.Name: Disable useplatformtick in BCD
DisableUsePlatformTick.Description: Disables forced platform timer ticks in Windows, leaving it up to the hardware. potentially improving performance. (Although, your PC is likely already configured to do this automatically)

TscSyncPolicyTweaks.Name: Set TSC sync policy to enhanced
TscSyncPolicyTweaks.Description: Enables a stricter synchronization policy for your CPU cores, potentially improving performance (especially on older computers)

DisableDynamicTick.Name: Disable Dynamic Tick
DisableDynamicTick.Description: Disables dynamic tick, which is a power saving feature on Windows that stops the periodic timer interrupts while idle. Enabling this tweak may improve latency or improve timer resync issues, but most of the time it's completely negligible and only makes your computer work harder.

DisableLegacyAPICMode.Name: Disable Legacy APIC mode in BCD
DisableLegacyAPICMode.Description: Disables legacy APIC compatibility mode, potentially improving efficiency.

Enablex2APIC.Name: Enable x2APIC mode
Enablex2APIC.Description: Enables x2APIC mode, which can improve interrupt latency. Usually on by default, never hurts to apply this tweak.
